newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Dec CPI seen at 3.4 percent - J.P. Morgan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Dec CPI seen at 3.4 percent - J.P. Morgan.

text.p: Mexico's inflation will come in at 3.4 percent rather than the 2.6 percent originally forecast, J.P. Morgan said in a market report.
The company said that the higher than expected price hikes in things like subway journeys, tortillas and milk were spurred by earlier public sector price hikes.
Secondly, a rise in inflationary pressures was triggered by the government's early-December announcement of an above-consensus inflation forecast for the month, it said.
Third, a stronger-than-expected expansion in aggregate demand may have enabled enterprises to raise prices at little cost to their sales, J.P. Morgan said.
